Hi! I'm completely new to this and don't know where to start, can you guide me?
Absolutely — here’s a simple place to start with your new Alen:
Take the purifier out of the box and remove all protective films. The filter is already inside the unit, so open the front panel and unwrap it.
Place your Alen along the room’s longest wall, at least 18 inches away from furniture.
Plug it in, press the power button, and leave it running 24/7 for best results.
Register your purifier using the serial number on the back of the unit and keep your proof of purchase. You can begin at the Alen onboarding page.
Consider setting up a filter subscription to receive replacement filters, save 10% on each filter, and receive free shipping.
Connect your purifier to Wi-Fi using the Alen Air app to control it remotely, monitor air quality, and receive filter replacement notifications.

Can you explain the main options in simple terms?
Of course. The main options are:
Room size: Alen purifiers clean one room at a time, so choose a model sized for the room where you’ll use it.
Fan speed: Higher speeds clean the air faster; lower speeds are quieter and take longer.
Auto mode: On models with a Smart Sensor, the purifier adjusts its fan speed based on the detected air quality.
Air-quality indicator: The color shows the particle level in the room. Blue indicates cleaner air, while red or purple indicates a higher particle level, depending on the model.
